sources.name: Google Search Central — Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
facts: Google recommends content that is helpful, reliable and created primarily for people.
Google strongly encourages accurate authorship information and bylines where readers would expect them.
Background about authors or the publishing site and clear sourcing can help users judge trust.
Disclosing how automation or AI was used can be useful when readers would reasonably expect that context.
Google says trust is the most important aspect within E-E-A-T.

sources.name: Google Search Central — Article structured data
facts: Article author may be a Person or Organization.
Google recommends author type plus url or sameAs to help disambiguate authors.
datePublished and dateModified are recommended where applicable.

sources.name: Schema.org — reviewedBy
facts: reviewedBy represents a Person or Organization that reviewed a WebPage for accuracy or completeness.
Keshavarz20 will not emit reviewedBy without a real verified reviewer.
